title: Bifunctor form and inverse of the normalized native section Hom comparison
statement: For every scheme Y and prime l, form the actual native internal Hom bifunctor HD. For every normalized section Hom comparison H [lem-sf-adic-module-hom-comparison-core], its components and two-variable naturality give a natural isomorphism HD followed by the actual native section equivalence functor to the two-variable transport of the ordinary slice Hom bifunctor. Reversing this specified isomorphism along that equivalence gives a natural isomorphism from ordinary slice Hom followed by its inverse to native Hom of the two inverse images.

source.place: Internal-Hom comparison and naturality of evaluation paragraph; ordinary small-site restriction and Frobenius translation.

proof.text: Define nativeHom by uncurrying native ihom and its source-variable ihomMap. Use H.homIso at each pair. The target ordinary curried Hom map is homObjMap(f,id) followed by homObjMap(id,g); normalize it with its composition equation and apply H.hom_naturality.

Apply the proved generic inverseHomComparison to the actual adicSectionModuleEquivalence and the forward comparison just constructed. The unit and counit factors give exactly the stated reverse comparison.

def inverseNativeHomComparison (H : AdicModuleHomComparisonCore l Y) :
    Functor.uncurry.obj (SheafOfModules.homFunctor (comparisonRing l Y)) ⋙
        (adicSectionModuleEquivalence l Y).inverse ≅
      (adicSectionModuleEquivalence l Y).inverse.op.prod
        (adicSectionModuleEquivalence l Y).inverse ⋙ nativeHom Y l
